description: Implementation of NullDecrypter class for QUIC protocol, handling decryption and hash computation.

classes.name: NullDecrypter
classes.description: A class implementing a null decrypter for QUIC, which performs no actual decryption but verifies packet integrity.

methods.name: SetKey
methods.description: Sets the decryption key, always returns true if key is empty.

methods.name: SetNoncePrefix
methods.description: Sets the nonce prefix, always returns true if empty.

methods.name: SetIV
methods.description: Sets the IV, always returns true if empty.

methods.name: SetHeaderProtectionKey
methods.description: Sets header protection key, always returns true if empty.

methods.name: SetPreliminaryKey
methods.description: Should not be called; triggers a bug.

methods.name: SetDiversificationNonce
methods.description: Sets diversification nonce, should not be called.

methods.name: DecryptPacket
methods.description: Performs a no-op decryption, verifying hash and copying plaintext.

methods.name: GenerateHeaderProtectionMask
methods.description: Returns a mask of five zero bytes.

methods.name: ReadHash
methods.description: Reads a 128-bit hash from the data reader.

methods.name: ComputeHash
methods.description: Computes a 128-bit hash based on data and perspective.
